title: Sink
description: spec of the Sink manifest: the address base, the class ceiling, the retention period and, for exports, export_only (E2).

base.description: Address base; the address is built from the base, the tenant and the delivery id (DLV-6). For driver webhook the base is the whole https:// address of the receiver (DLV-17).

ceiling.description: Ceiling of the class of what is written.

retention.description: Retention period of what is written.

recipient.description: Deprecated form kept for schema compatibility; rules and documents name only recipient_ref. Exactly one of the two is set (lint export_only_recipient).

recipient_ref.description: From v0.2: the only recipient: self (the person whose data the export holds, encrypted with the public key they supplied with their request; the only form for /mydata export and principal.export), admin (only for tenant.export) or the person as human:<id> (SEC-10). With self, key_ref names the store where the core keeps the requester key of each request.

config.description: Driver configuration; it is closed by the driver schema.

signing_key_ref.description: From v0.2, only for driver webhook: the deployment secret that signs every send (DLV-17).
